title: Broad exact-v6 counterfactual target reliability smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Candidate-continuation all-legal-action targets with independent future-runout confirmation can be reliable across both seats and all four streets before any state-conditioned weight update.
material_change: Generate a balanced 256-state exact physical-v6 dataset against four mixed-contract opponents, branch every legal action under 8+8 common-random future runouts, and gate target reliability before training.
source: Standard10 exact legacy-v4 bridge; four frozen trajectory opponents

notes: Initial launch stopped after one partial row due to bridge/native table index mismatch; partial evidence retained and excluded. Same-seed recovery authorized only after regression repair.

The failed launch deterministically completed the same 576 trajectory hands before branching; these are counted in addition to the recovery. Offline samples count only 128 durable failed-row rollouts plus 30,112 recovery rollouts; unknown non-durable partial work is not guessed.

result.summary: After an isolated action-table binding repair, the same-seed recovery collected 256 balanced exact-v6 states from 576 trajectory hands and completed 30,112 all-legal continuation rollouts. Development-selected actions had positive independent-confirmation mean delta, but overall action agreement was 78.9%, SB-preflop agreement 46.9%, and 26.6% of rows selected a new all-in.
result.conclusion: Future-runout confirmation alone does not make fixed-opponent-hole counterfactual targets reliable. The apparently large positive value is contaminated by hindsight over exact hidden holes and development action selection; action identity is unstable exactly where preflop hidden information matters, and the new-all-in rate reproduces the known catastrophic target pathology. The preregistered gate prevented any learned update.
result.next_step: Do not train or tune this dataset. The next data method must sample opponent holes from a history-consistent posterior (replaying the frozen opponent policy likelihood), share those posterior samples across legal actions, and pass the same independent action-identity and tail gates before any weights change.
